original_audit_text: Re-aim the binary program at the deployed sizes. Under the "D constant at 4" model the m = 4 cost scales like 2^{n/4} times a polynomial, against rho's 2^{n/2}. The committed gap of about 8 bits at n = 131 flips sign somewhere above it, and sect233, sect283, sect409 and sect571 are never priced. This is one calculation, and it decides whether the big-memory cells in item 7 are worth the machine.
